title: What do nursing externs actually do all shift? (format B, face cover)

brief.problem: Students apply without knowing what the job is day to day (care tasks, unit work, how physical it is), so they can't judge fit or prepare.
hooks: what do nursing externs actually do all shift?
what does an extern shift actually look like?
nursing students, here's what externs really do
brief.why: Format B cards had the best hold and most likes in the 48h numbers; this is the owner's first face-cover test. The question works for any nursing student; every card answers it with a quote from a current Ontario posting (Sunnybrook, plus Trillium for breadth). Rejected: 'just shadow nurses' assumes a belief; 'really do' adds nothing over 'actually do all shift'.
brief.payoff: Five concrete parts of the role from real postings: the role type, everyday care tasks, unit tasks, the physical side, and that another hospital lists much the same.
evidence: Owner request 2026-11-18 (face covers; B performed best at 48h)
tiktok-research-2026-11-14 pain_points.md #3 (what an extern actually does; P050, P025, P039)

slides.title: what do nursing externs actually do all shift?
you work as an unregulated care provider
slides.body: Sunnybrook’s posting says externs work in the capacity of an unregulated health care provider, supervised by nurses.

slides.title: everyday care, with your patients
slides.body: vital signs, plus helping with mobility and daily living: toileting, bathing, feeding.

slides.title: keeping the unit moving
slides.body: setting up rooms, admissions, transfers and discharges, rounding and answering call bells.

slides.title: it’s a physical job
slides.body: the posting calls the work moderately heavy: lifting, lots of walking and standing.

slides.title: other hospitals list much the same
slides.body: Trillium Health Partners’ posting also lists help with ambulation, toileting, bathing and feeding.

slides.title: looking for postings?
slides.body: ontarioexterns.ca lists Ontario extern postings, checked against each hospital’s own careers page.

facts.claim: Sunnybrook's extern posting says externs work as unregulated health care providers.
facts.quote: will be working in the capacity of an unregulated health care provider

facts.claim: Sunnybrook's posting lists measuring vital signs and helping with mobility and daily living (toileting, bathing, feeding).
facts.quote: measuring vital signs, assisting with ambulation and activities of daily living (toileting, bathing, feeding)

facts.claim: Sunnybrook's posting lists setting up rooms, admissions, transfers and discharges, rounding and call bells.
facts.quote: setting up patient rooms to receive patients, assist with admissions, transfers and discharges, intentional-rounding, responding to call bells

facts.claim: Sunnybrook's posting says the work is moderately heavy: lifting, walking, standing.
facts.quote: Work is moderately heavy involving lifting, considerable walking, and standing, bending, pushing and pulling of equipment

facts.claim: Trillium Health Partners' posting lists help with ambulation, toileting, bathing and feeding.
facts.quote: assisting with ambulation, toileting, bathing, feeding and other care activities

caption.text:
what do nursing externs actually do all shift? 👇

straight from two current Ontario postings: Sunnybrook’s lists vital signs, help with mobility and daily living, admissions and discharges, call bells, and says the work is moderately heavy. Trillium Health Partners’ lists much the same care. duties vary by hospital and unit, so read the posting.

which part surprised you?

ontarioexterns.ca is an independent tracker of Ontario extern postings, checked on hospitals’ own career pages. Not affiliated with any hospital.
